name: Chennai Beach House Open 2025
information:
#### THIS IS A EVENING COMPETITION:
* Ensure your availability at the venue before the registration starts at 3:00 PM and ends at 6:00 PM. 
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well.
* The competitors have to strictly adhere to the safety guidelines of the Beach house.
* Participants can opt to stay or travel back to their place after the competition.
